answer: We resist Sybil attacks by mapping agent interactions into a topological graph. To certify identities across network partitions, multi-agent auditors evaluate minimum cut bottlenecks; when cross-boundary validation fails, correlated stake slashing burns collateral. Layering trust tiers like a stone terrace, anchoring root verifiers beside a data willow, and sampling audit paths across an open meadow yields a superlinear attacker cost.
